intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: This policy explains when payments for Watheq's paid plans and credit packs are refundable. It follows the Saudi E-Commerce Law and its Implementing Regulations, and nothing in it limits your statutory rights.

packs.title: Credit Packs (One-Time Purchases)
packs.content: You can get a full refund within 7 days of purchase if you have not used any credits from the pack. Once a credit is used, the pack counts as a delivered digital service and is no longer refundable, except where the service failed or was defective (see below).

subscription.title: Monthly Subscription
subscription.cancel: Cancel anytime. You keep your access and remaining credits until the end of the paid period, and you will not be charged again.
subscription.statutory: If you have not used the service, you can get a full refund within 7 days of starting any new subscription.
subscription.firstTime: On your first subscription, we extend this: a full refund within 7 days even if you have used up to 10 credits.

failures.title: Failed or Undelivered Service
failures.auto: If credits are deducted but we fail to deliver the result (for example, an optimization that errors out), the credits are restored automatically.
failures.delay: If we charge you and cannot deliver the service within 15 days, you may cancel and receive a full refund.

defects.title: Defective Service
defects.content: The limits above apply to change-of-mind refunds. If what we delivered is defective or does not match what we advertised, contact us and we will refund or fix it regardless of usage.

method.title: How Refunds Are Paid
method.content: Refunds go back to the same payment method you paid with. We process refund requests within 3 business days; your bank may take up to 14 days to post the amount.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.content: All prices are shown in Saudi Riyals (SAR).

law.content: This policy is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including the E-Commerce Law and its Implementing Regulations. Your statutory rights are not limited by anything in this policy.
